llm_response.reason: The website https://billi.rangeity.shop/ claims to be operated by 有限会社寺本水産 (Teramoto Suisan Co., Ltd.), a legitimate oyster farming company. However, it sells a wide range of unrelated products at unusually low prices, which is a common characteristic of scam websites. The contact information and company details provided on the site match those of Teramoto Suisan Co., Ltd., but the business activities described on the site do not align with the legitimate business of the company, indicating potential misuse of the company's information.
